questions.question: The overhead inside rearview mirror should show:
questions.correctAnswerText: All students on the bus.
questions.explanation: The overhead inside rearview mirror should be positioned so the driver can see all students on the bus. This includes the heads of students sitting right behind the driver.

questions.question: Properly adjusted outside convex mirrors should allow the driver to see:

options.text: Where the front of each rear tire touches the ground.
Where the front of each front tire touches the ground.

questions.correctAnswerText: Where the front of each rear tire touches the ground.
questions.explanation: Outside convex mirrors should be adjusted so the driver can see at least one traffic lane on each side of the bus, the entire side of the bus up to the mirror mounts, and where the front of each rear tire touches the ground.

questions.question: Before a trip, you should check that:

options.text: The pedal surfaces are not worn smooth.

questions.correctAnswerText: The pedal surfaces are not worn smooth.
questions.explanation: During a pre-trip inspection, make sure nothing blocks the pedals. Check that all pedals work properly and that their surfaces are grooved, not worn smooth.

questions.question: If you must drive in high winds, you should:

options.text: Loosen your grip on the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: School buses can be pushed by wind because of their large sides. If you drive in windy conditions, grip the steering wheel firmly, expect wind gusts, and slow down. Contact your dispatcher if needed.

questions.question: During exercises other than straight line backing, you may exit your vehicle to check its position no more than:
questions.correctAnswerText: Two times.
questions.explanation: During a basic control skills test, you can exit your vehicle to check the vehicle's position. This is called a "look." For straight line backing, you can look only once. For other exercises, you can look twice.

questions.question: During a basic vehicle control skills test, what is an encroachment?

options.text: A driver placing the vehicle in neutral and applying the parking brake.
The vehicle touching an exercise boundary line.
A driver properly completing an exercise.
An applicant trying to bribe the examiner.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle touching an exercise boundary line.
questions.explanation: An encroachment is when any part of your vehicle touches or crosses an exercise boundary line. Every encroachment is counted as an error.

questions.question: Properly adjusted mirrors on a school bus allow the driver to see ____ behind the bus.
questions.correctAnswerText: 200 feet
questions.explanation: Mirrors must be adjusted correctly for safe bus operation. The flat mirrors should be set so the driver can see 200 feet, or about four bus lengths, behind the bus.

questions.question: If a driver needs to exit the bus to check that all waiting students have boarded, the driver should:

options.text: Turn the bus off and take the key.
Ask a student to watch the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn the bus off and take the key.
questions.explanation: If you need to exit the bus while students are boarding and a student is missing, secure the bus and take the key with you. Check around and underneath the bus for the missing student.

questions.question: When asked to make a turn during the driving test, you should:

options.text: Not use a turn signal since you were told to turn.
Check traffic only to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check traffic in all directions.
questions.explanation: When asked to make a turn during the on-road driving test, check traffic in all directions and use your turn signal.

questions.question: Before leaving a bus stop, a driver should:

options.text: Make sure no students are running to catch the bus.
Make sure students have placed their backpacks in the aisle.
Make sure students have opened the emergency vent.
Make sure students are facing the rear of the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure no students are running to catch the bus.
questions.explanation: Before leaving a bus stop, check that no students are running to catch the bus.

questions.question: When should you check the mirrors on a bus?

options.text: You do not need to check the mirrors

questions.correctAnswerText: Before you start driving
questions.explanation: Always check and adjust the bus mirrors before you drive. This helps you see clearly while operating the bus.

questions.question: Where are the danger zones around a school bus?

options.text: On the sides of the bus
In front, in back, and on the sides of the bus

questions.correctAnswerText: In front, in back, and on the sides of the bus
questions.explanation: Danger zones are areas where children are most likely to be hit by the bus or another vehicle. These areas are in front, in back, and on both sides of the bus.

questions.question: If the Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) stops working, what happens?

options.text: You should only use the parking brake to stop
You should stop and wait for the ABS to work again

questions.correctAnswerText: You will still have brakes
questions.explanation: The Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) prevents your brakes from locking up. If it stops working, your regular brakes will still work. You can continue to drive and brake normally.

questions.question: If you need to evacuate a bus, what should you do?

options.text: Have students stand no more than 50 feet from the bus
Have students stand downwind in case of fire
Lead students as far as possible from railroad tracks
Lead students away from oncoming traffic

questions.correctAnswerText: Lead students as far as possible from railroad tracks
questions.explanation: When evacuating a bus, lead students at least 100 feet away from the road. Keep them upwind if there is a fire. Stay as far away as possible from any railroad tracks.

questions.question: If you must back up at a student pickup point, when should you do it?

options.text: Before students get on the bus
After students get on the bus

questions.correctAnswerText: After students get on the bus
questions.explanation: Backing a school bus is dangerous and should be avoided. If you must back up, wait until all students have boarded the bus first.

questions.question: When inspecting the fifth wheel during a pre-trip check, what should you look for?

options.text: A gap between the kingpin and the locking jaws
The locking jaws fully closed around the kingpin

questions.correctAnswerText: The locking jaws fully closed around the kingpin
questions.explanation: When checking the fifth wheel, make sure the locking jaws are completely closed around the kingpin.

questions.question: What maneuvers might be on the basic vehicle control skills test?
questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above
questions.explanation: The basic vehicle control skills test may include straight line backing, right and left offset parking, parallel parking on both sides, and alley docking.

questions.question: When properly adjusted, how far behind the bus should the outside mirrors allow you to see?
questions.correctAnswerText: Four bus lengths
questions.explanation: The side mirrors should be adjusted so you can see 200 feet (or four bus lengths) behind the bus.

questions.question: During the on-road driving test, which action is NOT required?

options.text: Complete the test without an accident
Use your cell phone while driving

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your cell phone while driving
questions.explanation: During the on-road test, you must wear your safety belt, obey all traffic signs and laws, and drive safely without accidents. You should NOT use your cell phone while driving.

questions.question: When approaching a bus stop, what should students on your bus do?

options.text: Stand up and get their bags
Walk to the front of the bus to exit

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay seated
questions.explanation: Students must stay seated until the driver tells them it is safe to get up. It is not safe for students to walk around a moving bus.
